hero.purpose: The single giant figure — the Stats headline cost number (3.25rem). Never a title.

display.purpose: The Ticket page title — the one real headline (1.4375rem).

title.purpose: Board bands, run headers, section labels, and sidebar card labels (0.9375rem).

label.purpose: Uppercase field and section labels only (0.625rem, +0.09em).

code.purpose: Paths, branches, commands, hashes, and session IDs (0.8125rem, JetBrains Mono).

shadows.name: card-light
shadows.purpose: Quiet two-layer lift for Paper cards in light mode (--hm-shadow-card).

shadows.name: card-dark-ring
shadows.purpose: In dark, shadows fade on the dark field — a 1px hairline ring stands in for card lift.

shadows.name: bar
shadows.purpose: Status/command bar float with an edge ring (--hm-shadow-bar).

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Teal is for ordinary interface action, never review state.

components.name: Review action
components.description: Indigo is reserved for the operator's review turn.

components.name: Ghost action
components.description: Quiet secondary control on a Paper surface.

components.name: State pill
components.description: Tinted state signal with text, never color alone.

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Teal tooling voice on the current view.

narrative.overview: Harmonic is a dense operator console in a matte, low-chroma Paper register. Teal speaks for the interface and tooling; indigo marks the single state that needs the operator. The Board is ordered by attention, with the review gate always clear and reachable.
keyCharacteristics: Teal action and tooling voice with indigo review voice
True light and dark themes with Soft and Bold densities
Semantic state color that never carries meaning alone

rules.name: Two Voices
rules.body: Teal means action, tooling, and ready. Indigo means review and needs-you. Neither decorates generic content.

rules.name: Mono Is Code
rules.body: Use monospace only for code identities such as paths, branch refs, commands, hashes, and session IDs.

rules.name: Review Gate
rules.body: Reject is ghost and Accept & merge is teal, last, and sticky on the current run.

rules.name: Ink-Flip
rules.body: White-on-solid await/merged fills fail AA in dark; never darken the fill — flip the glyph ink per theme via --on-await / --on-done (white in light, dark ink in dark).

rules.name: Amber Exception (ADR-0033)
rules.body: Running amber measures 3.1–3.7:1 at ~10px — an accepted bounded exception because running is never carried by colour alone (pulsing dot + label + position). If amber ever becomes the sole carrier, it must meet AA independently.

dos: Do order the Board by what needs the operator now.
Do use teal for ordinary actions and indigo only for review.
Do use merged and merging in operator-facing copy.
Do flip glyph ink per theme on bright await/merged fills to hold AA.
donts: Don't use teal for review state.
Don't use monospace for ordinary prose or figures.
Don't give ready its own green — ready is teal, merged is emerald.
Don't darken the await/merged fills to chase AA, and don't restyle the Bold density (locked).
Don't reintroduce Deck row lists, connector lines, or a Kanban board.
